source: Quiz 4 - Sessions 1-5: Building and Improving Agent Skills
question: Why place a long, specialized writing guide in a reference linked from the main procedure?

options.text: Its instructions then become the input for every task
options.feedback: The guide remains reusable guidance, not the changing source content for each task.

options.text: It can be opened when that guidance is needed
options.feedback: Staged loading keeps the main procedure focused while making detailed guidance available for relevant steps.

options.text: The guide no longer needs a connection to the procedure
options.feedback: A useful reference supports the procedure. Separating it into a file does not remove the need to know when it applies.

options.text: It automatically becomes an executable writing program
options.feedback: A referenced document remains guidance. Executable operations belong to code, not prose made into a separate file.
